movelist.name: Lucky Chant
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Lucky Chant may activate it when receiving a Critical Hit to cause the attack to instead deal damage as if it was not a Critical Hit. Lucky Chant may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Ancient Power
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Refresh
movelist.effect: The user is cured of all Poison, Burns, and Paralysis.

movelist.name: Bubble Beam
movelist.effect: Bubble Beam lowers the target’s Speed on 18+.

movelist.name: Recover
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.trigger: The user is recalled into a Poké Ball, or Takes
abilities.effect: The user gains Hit Points equal to 1/3rd of its maximum Hit Points. Regenerator may be activated only once per Scene.

abilities.name: Hustle
abilities.effect: The user receives a -2 penalty to all Accuracy Rolls and gains a +10 Bonus to All Damage Rolls.
